status.en: 31 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 48% more than the week before, most of them in Manila, Philippine and Davao.
status.nb: 31 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 48 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Manila, Philippine og Davao.

summary.en: The Philippines is hosting an ASEAN Maritime Center to boost regional cooperation while negotiating a South China Sea code of conduct that is now 70 percent complete, and it has signed a defence deal with Australia amid rising tensions. Chinese vessels have entered Scarborough Shoal and continued patrols near Diaoyu Dao, prompting Manila to summon the Chinese ambassador, while the Philippine Coast Guard cleaned up an oil spill from a sunken landing craft tank off Surigao del Sur. The US Coast Guard cutter Bertholf conducted flight operations in the South China Sea, and former NPA rebels were redeployed as forest guards in Borongan. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinene er vert for et ASEAN Maritime Center for å styrke regionalt samarbeid mens de forhandler en kode for oppførsel i Sør-Kina-havet som nå er 70 prosent ferdig, og de har signert en forsvarsavtale med Australia midt i økende spenninger. Kinesiske fartøyer har gått inn i Scarborough-skjæra og fortsatte patruljer nær Diaoyu-dao, noe som fikk Manila til å innkalle den kinesiske ambassadøren, mens Filippinenes kystvakt ryddet opp et oljelekkasje fra en sunket landingskøretøytank utenfor Surigao del Sur. USAs kystvaktskip Bertholf gjennomførte flyoperasjoner i Sør-Kina-havet, og tidligere NPA-rebeller ble omplassert som skogvoktere i Borongan. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
